# Project Arthouse

> Project Arthouse is a marketing studio from India. It runs social media and ads, builds websites and landing pages, and sets up CRM and follow-up automation, as one team working from one plan. It also makes invitations and occasion websites for birthdays, weddings and celebrations.

Last updated: 2026-11-28. Marketing services are quoted in writing after a conversation. Invitations and occasion websites have fixed prices, listed in Indian rupees (INR) and US dollars (USD); each is a price in its own right, not a conversion.

## Marketing services

Grouped along the customer journey: get seen (social media, ads), make the case (websites), follow up (CRM and automation). Take one or all four; they are planned together.

### [Social media](https://www.projectarthouse.com/social-media.html)

Facebook, Instagram and YouTube, planned, designed and posted for you.

Includes:

- Social media management
- Post design
- Video design

Pricing: quoted in writing after a conversation, with scope and timeline attached.

Every enquiry caught, followed up and remembered.

Includes:

- Pipelines

Pricing: quoted in writing after a conversation, with scope and timeline attached.

## How the services fit together

1. Spot who is ready: someone saves a post, clicks an ad or reads the prices twice (social media, ads).
2. Say the right thing: a message written for that moment, on the channel they used (ads, social media).
3. Make yes easy: a page that answers the question and asks for the enquiry (websites).
4. Follow up, every time: the reply is caught, answered and remembered (CRM and automation).

## Ways to work together

- One project: a website, a campaign or a CRM setup, with a clear scope and date.
- A launch: website, social and the first ads, planned together for one launch day.
- A monthly team: social media, ads and the CRM run every month, with a report on what moved.

## How a project runs

1. Brief: tell us what you need and when.
2. Plan: scope, timeline and cost in writing; a short plan first for bigger work.
3. Make: design, build and write, with checkpoints.
4. Launch and run: hand over files, links and logins, or keep running it monthly and report what moved.

## Where it started: [Invitations and occasion websites](https://www.projectarthouse.com/occasion-websites.html)

Before it became a marketing studio, Project Arthouse made personal websites for one person or one day: birthday reveals, wedding invitations, Grihapravesh and family invitations, Father's Day and Valentine's pages. They open from a private link on any phone. The studio still makes them.

Plans and prices:
- 1 Day Birthday: INR 1199 or USD 39.99. A personal one-day birthday website with photos, wishes, a heartfelt note, and a soft reveal experience. Includes: 1 custom birthday page; Photos + birthday message; Mobile-friendly design; Soft reveal animation; Private shareable link.
- 3 Day Curated Reveal: INR 1399 or USD 59.99. Three connected reveal moments that unfold like a tiny emotional journey, perfect when one page feels too small. Includes: 3 reveal chapters; Countdown-style flow; Photo + letter sections; Interactive final reveal; Private shareable link.
- 7 Day Unfolding Experience: INR 1699 or USD 69.99. A week-long digital experience with memories, clues, photos, notes, and a final emotional reveal. Includes: 7-day unlock flow; Daily memories + notes; Mini interaction option; Premium animations; Final cinematic reveal.
- Wedding Invitation: INR 1299 or USD 49.99. A polished wedding invitation website with couple names, programme details, celebration notes, and a private shareable link. Includes: Digital wedding invite; Couple story section; Programme details; Mobile-friendly design; Private shareable link.
- Grihapravesh: INR 1299 or USD 49.99. A graceful digital invitation for Grihapravesh, housewarming, puja, family gathering, or a new home celebration. Includes: Custom invitation page; Date, venue + timing; Family message section; Mobile-friendly design; Private shareable link.
- Father's Day: INR 1299 or USD 49.99. A warm digital tribute for Dad with photos, messages, memories, lessons, and one beautiful thank-you reveal. Includes: Father's Day tribute page; Photos + heartfelt message; Hero moments section; Soft reveal animation; Private shareable link.
- Valentine's Day (1 Day): INR 1199 or USD 39.99. A personal Valentine's Day website with photos, a love note, sweet memories, and a private reveal moment. Includes: 1 romantic reveal page; Photos + love message; Cute interactive flow; Mobile-friendly design; Private shareable link.
- Valentine's Week (8 Days): INR 2099 or USD 79.99. An 8-day Valentine's Week experience with daily reveals, memories, notes, romantic prompts, and a final surprise. Includes: 8-day unlock journey; Daily love notes; Photos + memories; Premium animations; Final romantic reveal.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Project Arthouse?

Project Arthouse is a marketing studio from India. It runs social media and ads, builds websites and landing pages, and sets up CRM and follow-up automation, as one team working from one plan. It also makes invitations and occasion websites.

### Do I have to take every service?

No. Take one service or all four. They come from the same studio, so anything you add later fits with what is already there.

### Which ad platforms and CRMs do you work with?

For ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Search and YouTube. For CRM, usually Zoho or HubSpot, or the tool you already pay for.

### How much does it cost?

Marketing work is quoted after a conversation, because scope varies. You get scope, timeline and cost in writing before any work begins. Invitations have fixed prices, from ₹1,199 or $39.99.

### Do you still make invitations?

Yes. Birthday reveals, wedding invitations, Grihapravesh invitations, Father's Day and Valentine's pages, with fixed prices on the rate card.

### Do you work with clients outside India?

Yes. The studio is based in India and works online with clients anywhere.

### How do I start?

Send a brief through the form, by WhatsApp or by email. A few lines is enough. We reply in writing before any work begins.

### Which ad platforms do you run?

Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Search and YouTube.

### How much should I spend on ads?

Enough to learn from in the first month. We suggest a starting budget in the proposal, based on your goal and market, and change it once real numbers come in.

### Do I own the ad accounts?

Yes. Campaigns run in accounts in your name, and you keep them, with all their history, if we stop working together.

### How are ads priced?

A monthly fee for our work, quoted in writing after a conversation. The ad budget is separate.

### Which CRM do you use?

The one that fits your size and budget: often Zoho or HubSpot, sometimes something simpler. If you already pay for a CRM, we set up that one.

### Can it connect to WhatsApp?

Yes. Through the WhatsApp Business platform and the CRM's own connectors, so chats and leads end up in the same place.

### Will my team actually use it?

We set it up around how your team already sells, keep it simple and train them. A CRM nobody opens is the most expensive kind.

### How is CRM work priced?

By scope. We talk first, then send a written quote before any work begins.
